about: A client interface (客户端控件 with a Lua client script, game version 7.1) made with scene_set_client_script and scene_add_client_ui. On a dark panel at the top left three red discs stand for the player variable CU_lives (3 at first); the level's graph takes one away at level seconds 12 and 16 and the Lua, which listens for the change of the variable, hides a disc each time. At the bottom a blue round button: a click on it makes the Lua send the signal CU_click, the graph hears it (prints CU_CLICK) and adds one to CU_score, and the Lua draws the green bar above the button one step longer. The script clicks the button at play seconds 4, 5 and 6: three CU_CLICK prints and a bar three steps long. Screenshots at 2 (three discs, short bar), 8 (two discs after second 12 of the level clock, which runs five or six seconds ahead; longer bar) and 13 (one disc).
